hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Each operation deletes the first occurrence of every distinct character present in the string.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Only characters that appear with the maximum overall frequency will survive into the very last operation.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Find the maximum frequency mx, and collect the last occurrence of each character whose count equals mx.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two-pass frequency counting and last-occurrence collection.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating the deletion operations step by step takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space for 26 lowercase English letters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that the final surviving round retains exactly the last instances of maximal frequency characters.
